Sunflora

Grass

Johto · Generation 2

Sunflora is a Grass-type Sun Pokémon first found in Johto (Generation 2). It stands 0.8 m tall and weighs 8.5 kg. It evolves from Sunkern. Its highest base stat is Sp. Atk (105), with a base stat total of 425.
